title: Seagrove Social
meta_description: Find the perfect 30A, FL vacation rental at “Seagrove Social”, a luxury 8-bed, 8 full & 2 half-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 26 guests, this home offers a Private Pool & Spa, Game Room, Rooftop Deck, Elevator, & Golf Cart. Book your stay now!
description_expanded: Home Highlights: – Gulf views – Approximately 250 Steps to Beach – Private resort style pool and spa (Pool can be heated for an additional $70 per day from October 1 - May 1) - Complimentary beach setups include 2 chairs and 1 umbrella - Service provided Mar 1-Oct 31 – Outdoor oasis featuring an expansive outdoor kitchen, Wolf grill, and TV – Rooftop deck – Game room with pool table, foosball, and wet bar - Elevator - Peloton shown is based on availability and pricing - 6 seater Golf Cart included - Six Adult Bikes Discover the epitome of coastal luxury in this breathtaking 30A vacation retreat, designed to elevate your beach getaway into an unforgettable experience. Perfectly located just 250 steps from the sugar-white sands of the Gulf, this magnificent home combines sophisticated design with unparalleled amenities. With sweeping Gulf views and contemporary finishes throughout, every detail of this residence has been meticulously crafted to embody modern elegance and comfort. Step into your private resort-style outdoor haven, where a sparkling pool and spa invite you to unwind in serenity. Surrounding the pool is a spacious sun deck, the perfect place to soak up the Florida sunshine, relax with a good book, or enjoy refreshing beverages poolside. The expansive outdoor space is an entertainer’s dream, featuring a fully equipped kitchen with a top-of-the-line Wolf grill, a large-screen TV, and ample seating for dining alfresco. Ascend to the rooftop terrace, where panoramic Gulf views create a stunning backdrop for morning coffee or evening cocktails under the stars. Inside, the home’s contemporary finishes and modern interiors exude understated luxury, with clean lines, high ceilings, and an open floor plan that invites natural light to flow through every room. The chef’s kitchen is a culinary masterpiece, boasting premium appliances and an oversized island perfect for preparing meals or gathering with loved ones. For entertainment, the game room serves as the ultimate hub of fun, offering a wet bar, pool table, and foosball for guests of all ages to enjoy. With 8 spacious bedrooms, 8 full baths, and 2 half baths, this home comfortably accommodates up to 26 guests, offering privacy and comfort in every suite. The inclusion of a Peloton bike (availability and pricing apply) ensures fitness enthusiasts can maintain their routine, while the convenience of a 6-seater golf cart and six adult bikes makes exploring the charm of 30A a breeze. An elevator connects each level, ensuring ease of access throughout the home. Every moment in this exceptional residence is an invitation to indulge in the finest aspects of coastal living. Whether lounging on the sun deck, entertaining on the rooftop terrace, or retreating to your beautifully appointed bedroom, this home promises an unmatched blend of style, comfort, and adventure. Reserve your stay today and immerse yourself in the ultimate luxury vacation experience on 30A. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS FIRST FLOOR – Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only – Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only – Bunk Room: Two Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, One Queen-over-Queen Bunk Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only SECOND FLOOR -Master Suite: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub THIRD FLOOR – Junior Master: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub – Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only – Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only - Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower Only – Two twin-over-twin bunk beds, Shared bathroom with Shower Only CONVENIENT LOCATION: Seaside Beach (Approx. 1.5 miles east) A charming beach community known for its picturesque streets and beautiful beaches. Topsail Hill Preserve State Park (Approx. 7 miles west) Features over three miles of pristine beaches, rare coastal dune lakes, and old-growth longleaf pine forests. Alys Beach (Approx. 5 miles east) A luxurious, architecturally unique community with stunning white-sand beaches and upscale dining and shopping options. Rosemary Beach (Approx. 6 miles east) A picturesque, vibrant community offering elegant architecture, boutique shopping, and dining along with beautiful beaches. Grayton Beach (Approx. 5 miles west) A laid-back beach town with a bohemian vibe, known for its pristine beaches and the famous Grayton Beach State Park. The Big Chill (Approx. 1.5 miles east) A lively venue offering a relaxed atmosphere with beach views, food, drinks, and entertainment. Grocery Store: Publix Super Market (Approx. 2 miles northeast) A full-service grocery store offering fresh produce, deli items, and household essentials. Seagrove Village Market Cafe (Less than 0.5 miles south) A local favorite since 1949, offering seafood and classic American fare in a casual setting. The Perfect Pig @ Gulf Place (Approx. 1 mile east) A Southern café and gourmet market serving breakfast, lunch, and dinner. **During peak season, all of our properties are rented with a 7-night minimum from Saturday to Saturday.**
